description:
Palantir builds software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE), you are deployed directly to real-world customer missions.

lists.content:
• Deploy production distributed pipelines to process terabytes of mission-critical data.
  • Build real-time analytical dashboards using TypeScript, React, and Python microservices.
  • Partner directly with operations leaders to understand frontline pain points.

• B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Strong proficiency with Java, Go, C++, or Python.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex distributed environments under time constraints.

additional: Palantir is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

customQuestions.text: Do you currently hold an active U.S. Government security clearance?
